artworks.title: Albrecht Dürer at Age Fifty-Six
artworks.medium: woodcut on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a profile view of the upper half of a man, facing left. He is depicted in a seated position with his head turned to the side. The man has strong, defined features with a prominent nose and a thick, full beard and mustache. His hair is styled in a straight, shoulder-length cut with a center parting. He is wearing a garment with a wide, rounded collar and visible stitching. The background is plain and features a coat of arms at the top left corner with architectural elements and stylized text “Albrecht Dürers Contrefeyt” above the figure.

artworks.title: The Cobbler's Unruly Family
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper

artworks.title: Distinguished Amateurs no. II: The Art Critic
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink over graphite with scratching-out on wove paper
artworks.description:
This image is a detailed line drawing of six people standing in a row, engaged in conversation or observation. The individuals are shown in full view. The first person on the left is a woman wearing a long gown and a coat with a high collar and long sleeves, with short hair style, holding her hands together. Next to her is another woman in an ornate dress and hat with feathers or similar embellishments, appearing friendly. The central figure is a man in a long coat, holding a hat against his hip, with curly hair falling around his shoulders. Adjacent to him is a woman in Victorian-style clothing with a decorative hat and veil, holding an umbrella. Near her is another woman in a long dress and a hat with flowers, holding up her dress train. Lastly, an older man stands in a dignified posture, wearing a long coat with a high collar, possibly with receding hair at the temples.

The background displays a wall with framed paintings, suggesting an art gallery or a well-appointed room. The shading and style imply depth and texture in the surroundings, with additional ornate furnishings like chairs visible, completing the environment without overt clutter.

artworks.title: Marie-Rosalie Vanloo
artworks.artist: Louis-Marin Bonnet after Carle Van Loo
artworks.medium: chalk manner printed in black and white on gray-brown paper
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a young girl in a side profile from the shoulders up. She is facing left, looking forward with delicate facial features, including a soft, rounded forehead and a small nose. Her hair is styled in a detailed, voluminous manner, appearing curly and falling in waves at the back of her head. She wears an ornate dress with an intricate design around the shoulders and neckline. The background is a plain, textured surface.

artworks.title: Hunter on Horseback
artworks.medium: chiarascuro woodcut printed from 2 blocks: black line block and ochre tone block on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a person on horseback traveling along a path beside a stream. A village is seen in the distance, with a horizon high in the composition and clouds in the sky. The style features fine lines and cross-hatching typical of woodcut prints, with a color palette of browns and deep sepia. A group of detailed trees frames the left side of the scene.

artworks.title: Gravure en Taille-douce: pl. I
artworks.artist: Antonio Baratta after A.-J. de Fehrt
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a workshop interior and engraving tools. The upper section of the illustration shows a detailed interior scene of a workshop where multiple individuals are engaged in various activities related to metal or engraving work. There are large windows letting in light, and various worktables are set up with instruments and papers. Below, the image features an assortment of engraving tools, each meticulously labeled with letters and numbers.

artworks.title: Gravure en Bois, Outils: pl. I
artworks.artist: Antonio Baratta after A.-J. de Fehrt and J.-R. Lucotte
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a workshop scene with tools for wood engraving. The upper part of the image depicts an interior with multiple workbenches and tools laid out, while the lower section shows labeled illustrations of various tools used in the craft. The workspace is detailed with several tables, each displaying different apparatus, and the walls are adorned with framed images. In the lower section, various engraving tools are depicted, each labeled with figure numbers and letters for identification.

artworks.title: Imprimerie en Taille Douce: pl. I
artworks.artist: French 18th Century after Robert Benard and Louis-Jacques Goussier
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a printing workshop with various tools and equipment depicted. It shows a detailed interior of an old-style printing operation. In the top section, there is a room where various printing activities are taking place, such as the operation of a printing press and preparation of ink and materials. Hanging illustrations or prints line the walls and are carefully displayed overhead. Several workstations are present, each with specific tasks and tools showcasing the intricate labor involved in the printing process. The bottom section of the drawing presents a close-up view of various tools integral to the printing process, including a printing press with labeled components, a basin for ink, and other key instruments. This illustration highlights the historical process of intaglio printing in an informative manner, giving insight into the craftsmanship and technology of historical printmaking.

artworks.title: Kaiser Sigmund
artworks.medium: hand-colored woodcut on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a regal figure seated on a throne. The person holds a sword and a golden orb with a cross on top. The bearded figure wears a crown, pink robe, and blue clothing. The throne is decorated, with a green backdrop. Two heraldic shields are displayed with black eagles on yellow backgrounds. A small dog is on the floor, and the background includes the throne backdrop and heraldic symbols. The upper part shows old script.

artworks.title: The Old Peasant Girard
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of an older man seated and facing slightly to the left. He has a hat in his lap and wears an expressive expression with long, wavy hair, a coat, and a simple shirt. The background is plain and dark.

artworks.title: Die betende nonne (The Praying Nun)
artworks.medium: etching on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a black and white etching of an outdoor scene with dense foliage, an architectural structure, and a nun in prayer. Trees, a shrine, and a stone archway also feature in the scene, with detailed lines and a monochromatic color palette emphasizing contrast.

artworks.title: Woman before a Fire
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated in an ornate chair, holding a book in her lap and leaning forward slightly with her head propped on her hand. She appears engrossed in reading. The woman's facial features are illuminated by the room's light, and she has styled hair with a decorative accessory. She wears an elegant gown with voluminous fabric that gathers around her legs. The room is richly decorated, with an intricate fireplace, a candelabra with lit candles, and elaborate wall designs in the background. Another ornate empty chair is beside her.

artworks.title: A Group of Monks and a Woman
artworks.artist: John Skippe after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed from 4 blocks in green, olive, gray-brown, and brown on laid paper; laid down on album page
artworks.description: The image shows the upper bodies and heads of six individuals standing closely together. They have distinct facial features, expressions, long beards, and various hairstyles. The individuals wear flowing robes, with one person wearing a hood. The robes are textured and drape down to their feet. There are no visible accessories. The background is a neutral color with a signature in the upper right corner.

artworks.title: A Sibyl Reading
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed from 2 blocks: brown line block and gray-brown tone block on laid paper; laid down on album page
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated on a square pedestal, holding an open book up to their face with one hand. The person is sideways with one knee bent and the other leg dangling. Their head is covered with a cloth, and their facial features are obscured. The clothing is long and flowing, covering the body completely. Another figure is crouched nearby, partly obscured. In the background, there is an architectural feature with sculptures of two cherubic figures. The scene is depicted in a monochromatic tone with detailed line work for shading and textures.

artworks.title: Edmond de Goncourt
artworks.medium: etching and engraving in black on Japan paper
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting facing slightly to his left. He has a serious expression and is wearing a dark coat over a light shirt with a large bow tie. He has expressive eyes, a mustache, and short, wavy light-colored hair. He is sitting at a surface with a book and a set square, holding a smoking pipe. In the background, there is a sculpted relief of mythological figures and a circular ornament with a bird motif.

artworks.title: Jupiter and Ganymede Above an Extensive Landscape
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper, the two figures (only) incised (laid on late eighteenth/early nineteenth-century mount)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a large eagle carrying a small figure on its back, flying through the sky. The drawing shows fine lines for the feathers, clouds, and landscape with hints of mountains in the background. The detailed feathering and shading give the image depth and movement.

artworks.title: François-Paul Meurice
artworks.medium: salted paper print
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Richard and Judith Smooke
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated with a relaxed posture. He is wearing a suit with a high-collared shirt, tie, and buttoned jacket. The man has a distinct mustache and his hair is neatly parted to one side and hanging to about ear length. He is looking slightly downward. The background appears softly blurred.

artworks.title: House with a Portico at Ermenonville
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a classical building in a forested area. A stone stairway leads up to the building, with columns and arched windows visible. Tall trees with slim trunks surround the structure, and the foliage dominates the upper portion of the image. The artwork is in light gray pencil on cream-colored paper, conveying a soft and airy feel.

artworks.title: Mariage d'argent; Le Fardeau de la liberté; Un Client sérieux [recto]
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on light brown wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a theater performance program and an illustration. The image features a program for a representation at Théâtre Antoine, organized by Les Amis de M. Gemier, detailing the plays to be performed, including "Mariage d'Argent" and "Le Fardeau de la Liberté," amongst others. On the right side of the program, there is an illustration of a figure reading a document. The figure is wearing a long coat and hat. The illustration is signed as a work by Toulouse-Lautrec. The program itself is filled with details of the performances, including the names of actors, plays, and some dramatic and comedic interludes.

artworks.title: "Crinolina" - and the Consequences [recto]
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with watercolor and scratching-out (around the ghosts' eyes on the right) on wove paper

artworks.title: "Taking the Air" in Hyde Park [verso]
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a lively outdoor scene with elegantly dressed individuals. The drawing depicts an outdoor gathering where numerous figures are dressed in 19th-century fashion. The central focus is on the elaborate costumes with voluminous skirts and fine details. In the middle ground, a woman is suspended in mid-air, adding a sense of motion. The background features trees and gentle shading.

artworks.title: Half-Nude Woman Holding Her Hair Apart
artworks.medium: charcoal with black and brown chalks on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert Paul Mann and Dorothy Neeld Mann
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright. The individual is facing forward and holding their long hair with both hands. The person's facial features are minimalistic, with basic lines for a nose and eyes. Their upper body is bare, and they are wearing a dark skirt or garment covering the hips and legs. The background is a textured, earthy-toned expanse with no discernible objects.

artworks.title: Chalet
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint in green-black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert Paul Mann and Dorothy Neeld Mann
artworks.description: The image shows a wooden house with a steep, triangular roof and a pointed cupola. In the background, mountains rise against the sky. The artwork is presented on an etched surface, with a mirrored reflection of the house below, giving the impression of water. The etching captures details of the house and terrain with fine lines and cross-hatching, creating a monochromatic color palette of various shades of gray.

artworks.title: La Fille d'Artaban; La Nébuleuse; Dialogue inconnu
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring abstract figures and text related to a theatrical program. The artwork has a monochrome design with a shadowy interplay of dark and light creating a haunting atmosphere. On the left, there is a nebulous form resembling a crouched figure and a reaching hand in a large dark area. Text on the right details theatrical performances at Le Théâtre Libre, including the plays "La Fille d'Artaban," "La Nébulese," and "Dialogue Inconnu," along with their casts. The drawing captures early theatrical promotion with moody imagery and detailed typography. This is in the style of Odilon Redon.
